source: Direct user instructions received after Slovenia 1979-1982 and their one-pass edits were already dispatched.

supersedes: Europe 1-20 tight hemline / 21-60 three-quarter / 61-100 full-body mapping
Every face, hand, leg and shoe must fit every crop
Four parallel standing lanes and identical shoe families across all characters
Old 15-percent tattoo placement within 32-percent character branding
preserves: Exactly four original fictional women age21, identities anchored938/936/937
One ChatGPT tailoring invocation per usable Meta occurrence; no second call even if interrupted or blocked
At most two Meta hard-failure retries; no aesthetic retries
Visible in-app Meta Thinking only; no provider APIs or hidden controls
Preserve raw, unused, blocked, selected assets and all URLs
No replacement automation, task, worker, subagent or guardian

randomness.algorithm: SHA256 with rejection sampling; every field has a unique recorded key. Fixed version+batch+country seed, no salt hunting or outcome rerolling.
randomness.unit: Per scene for camera and retained image rolls; per character per scene for shoes, flags, midriff and every tattoo motif.

camera.cropPriority: Rolled crop is real, not a label pasted on a head-to-toe lineup. Extreme close may omit lower legs and shoes. Intermediate may be waist/thigh-up or seated three-quarter. Extreme wide is an environmental narrative with distributed poses.

poses.selection: Seeded shuffle without replacement across four scene positions; not a probability claim.
poses.composition: Use different elevations, torso directions and foreground depths. Four faces retain their identity order but bodies need not stand shoulder-to-shoulder. No equal spacing or static catalogue row.
poses.safety: Consensual fully clothed adult affection; stable bench or daybed; supported head and neck; no straddling or intimate-area framing.

shoes.typeSelection: Seeded five-type deck rotates by scene and character; four distinct families per image and changed families across consecutive scenes.
shoes.brandStyle: When branded, an independent unbiased two-way choice: subtle exact RAZE text or original RAZE split-star. Otherwise brandless.
shoes.interpretation: The 40-percent branded / 60-percent brandless split applies independently to every shoe design, including rainbow. Rainbow does not silently force additional branding.
shoes.regularDesign: Distinct restrained colors, materials, hardware and silhouettes; no unrelated trademarks or Razer snake logo.

garments.flagRule: Selected garments integrate the complete current national flag design with correct order and proportions; not a random color fragment. Clothing remains wearable and opaque. A crop may show only part of the garment, but its designed motif remains complete.
garments.openBackAndBareArms: Every future single tailoring pass includes open-back or side-back construction and bare arms where visible, with opaque front and secure side coverage. Do not rotate bodies to force back visibility.
garments.shortHem: One substantial upper-thigh tailoring pass with secure opaque lining, bare leg styling where hosiery does not cover it; no underwear exposure.
garments.midriffRule: Apply the recorded roll in the same single tailoring invocation, not another edit; tasteful cropped or waist-cutout couture, secure opaque chest and pelvic coverage.

tattoos.placement: Prominent crisp visible upper arm, shoulder, upper back or outer calf; choose a visible non-intimate location for the rolled crop. Separate multiple motifs with readable spacing.
tattoos.countryMotifs: Original non-graphic designer symbols inspired by the setting; do not claim invented motifs are authentic national or religious symbols.

retainedCharacterStockingBranding.placement: stocking only, not an additional tattoo lottery; do not force socks into an extreme-close crop

editAllowance.ifAlreadyInvoked: Never revise by issuing another edit. Apply newer user directives prospectively.

browserGate.ifUnavailable: Persist prepared prompts locally; do not dispatch through API, direct HTTP, CLI, Chrome, computer-use or hidden-state substitutes.
